move: six component cards stagger in; toggle, button, slider, checks, pill all cycle
how: A 3x2 grid of white cards enters with a grid stagger (y 40, scale .96, expo.out). Each card then loops its own component over 7s: the toggle knob slides x 0/56 with back.out(1.8) and tints blue at 11%, 43%, 71%; the button presses to scale .94 and recovers elastic with a ripple twice; the slider thumb and fill (left %, scaleX) sweep to 72, 30 then 100 with power3.inOut and a counter tooltip; three checkboxes fill with back.out(2.5) and DrawSVG ticks, untick and re-tick; a segmented pill hops xPercent 0/100/200 with back.out; avatars pop and a toast slides in and out twice. At 93% the cards lift out from the end of the grid.
adapt: Rename labels and the button/toast copy, swap the four accent colours, and drop cards you do not need; keep the back.out toggle and elastic press timings, they are the tactile feel.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the six cards; animate returns one timeline with the per-component helper calls placed at fractions of D (tog at 0.11D, 0.43D, 0.71D etc.). Direct port apart from scoping the .val querySelector and registering DrawSVG.
caveats: many simultaneous tweens; fine for render, dense for editing
